d870.Raw_Article: 870 Ta. ē increase, abundance, pile, looking upward, pride, arrogance; ēntu (ēnti-) to rise high, be elevated, be eminent, excellent; ēntal height, dignity; ēttu (ētti-) to praise, extol; n. praising, extolling. Ma. ēntuka to rise; ēttākkaḷ praisers, singers (? < Ta.). Ka. (PBh.) esakam glory, magnanimity. Te. ēcu to increase, grow; ēcina exceeding, great, extreme; ēpu bloom, increase, growth, prosperity; spirit, ardour; ēdu to bring up, nourish, cherish, protect; edugu to grow, increase in stature; esãgu to increase (intr.) ; esakamu increase, rise; esa excess, superiority; very, excessively; esalāru to increase; (K.) ē̆saru to increase, flourish, exceed. Kuwi (Isr.) epa ā- to increase. ? Malt. ite to spring up (as seed); itgre, itre to be hatched. Cf. 3730 Ta. niva . DED(S) 739.
